name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box in the other room, and Precedence(door_open, key_lost) bans dropping the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. The key_lost event already requires door_open to be false, so the clause matches the task's wording.

texts: The agent must pick up the box in the other room (the mission's target box).
The agent must not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: the key_lost event may not occur before door_open has become true.
